about: Silhouette Characters: the NPC records each preset of "Silhouette Characters.xml" is bound to (tools/pool/characters.py, S-66).

Piper Wright.vibe: wiry, restless reporter: slim, small-chested, narrow hips, a real waist

Cait.vibe: cage fighter: lean muscle, strong shoulders and legs, a small hard chest

Curie.vibe: a new synth body, soft and unassuming: gentle curves, a little soft at the middle

Magnolia.vibe: lounge singer, the Commonwealth's one real hourglass

Desdemona.vibe: Railroad leader, middle-aged and severe: long, flat and square

Glory.vibe: the Railroad's heavy: a powerful, broad-shouldered athlete

Haylen.vibe: scribe, bookish: a desk body, soft arms and a soft belly

Madison Li.vibe: scientist in her fifties: thin and narrow, gone soft at the middle

Mama Murphy.vibe: old chem-worn seer: frail and sagging, thin limbs

Marcy Long.vibe: bitter survivor: hard, thin, worn out

Fahrenheit.vibe: Hancock's bodyguard: big, broad, muscled and heavy

Irma.vibe: Memory Den hostess: faded glamour, soft and full-figured

Mags Black.vibe: the Operators' boss: slim, elegant, cold

Nisha.vibe: the Disciples' leader: sinewy and knife-lean, all tendon

Ronnie Shaw.vibe: old Minutemen veteran: stocky, thick-waisted, tough

Myrna.vibe: sour shopkeeper: pear-shaped, thick through the hips

Doctor Amari.vibe: neuroscientist, middle-aged: ordinary and a little soft

Trudy.vibe: Drumlin Diner owner: a heavy apple shape

Ellie Perkins.vibe: the detective's secretary: plain and average

Carla.vibe: caravan trader: lean and weathered, a walker's legs

Captain Avery.vibe: Far Harbor's leader: a sturdy fisherwoman with a broad back

Ivy.vibe: NX-2C pleasure bot on a Courser combat chassis, a raider boss's brain: an engineered hourglass over toned muscle (the owner's pick, option A, 2026-09-24; made fuller by their poll the same night: "too slim" at breasts 25 / butt 15; then, by a rendered poll, option B: a big powerful glute shelf, "a woman with powerful ass muscles" cannot have a small one, and a more muscled back and arms)

Geneva.vibe: the mayor's secretary, famous among players for being hot: sleek and office-neat -- a perky bust, a slim waist, a high round bottom (the owner's pick from three renders, option B, 2026-09-25; the pool had rolled her a Boxy body)

Polly.vibe: the Choice Chops butcher who secretly writes poems about dancing in the dark: a butcher's meaty arms, shoulders and belly, and under them a dancer's round bottom

Cathy.vibe: the salon gossip who greets you with "You look terrible": bloodshot, graying -- and a wreck herself, skinny-fat and sagging

Becky Fallon.vibe: Fallon's Basement, "quality and affordability": everything has sunk to the basement -- a small bust over enormous hips, thighs and bottom

Scarlett.vibe: the Dugout Inn waitress, "hopefully nothing will poison ya": she never eats what she serves -- bony, run off her feet

Roxy.vibe: Atom Cats greaser in street clothes: a grease-monkey's wiry arms and a cocky little swagger at the hips

Rowdy.vibe: Atom Cats bruiser in leather, named for what she is: broad shoulders, heavy forearms, solid all through

Alana Secord.vibe: the Institute's cold, climbing department head in office wear: a pressed, narrow, upright body with no spare ounce

Rosalind Orman.vibe: the Institute's veteran director of robotics, in a suit: decades at a desk under the ground -- broad, soft and settled

Allie Filmore.vibe: the Institute's synth-retention zealot, wound tight: a tense, rail-thin body that never relaxes

Kessler.vibe: Bunker Hill's boss, who keeps the caravans and the Institute and the Brotherhood all at arm's length: a tough trader built square, tactical clothes over solid muscle

Kay.vibe: Bunker Hill local in street clothes: an ordinary, sturdy settler, a little thick at the waist

Deb.vibe: Bunker Hill trader who sells you everything at her stall: a comfortable, well-fed shopkeeper

Rachel.vibe: Vault 81 cook in her vault suit: she tastes everything she makes -- round, soft and homely

Tina De Luca.vibe: Vault 81's restless young flirt, who wants out to see the world: petite and curvy, a pin-up in a vault suit

Katherine Pinn.vibe: Katy of Vault 81, shirt over her suit: a soft, ordinary vault-born body that never walked a mile

Alexis Combes.vibe: Vault 81 mother in a tactical suit, ready to fight for her family: a solid, capable, broad-hipped body

Doctor Penske.vibe: Vault 81's doctor, all clinic and no bedside manner, in a dark nurse's uniform: tall-looking, lean and severe

Gwen McNamara.vibe: Vault 81's Overseer, armour over her suit: an authority in her fifties -- square-shouldered, thick-waisted, immovable

Penny Fitzgerald.vibe: Covenant's cheerful hostess in a party dress, smiling over a town that tests you for synths: a too-perfect doll's figure -- nothing out of place, which is the unsettling part

Wilhelmina Cabot.vibe: the Cabots' mother, kept alive for centuries by the Lazarus serum and locked in her room, still in an evening dress: preserved, not young -- a dried-out, sagging, brittle body

Tessa.vibe: the Gunner commander who holds Quincy after the massacre, in Gunner kit with a radio: a hard, drilled soldier, muscle under the webbing

Captain Bridget.vibe: Gunner captain in shoulder plates: a heavy, brawny mercenary who leads from the front

Rei Nakano.vibe: Kasumi's mother, sick with worry since her daughter ran away: a middle-aged body grown thin and tired

Cassie Dalton.vibe: Far Harbor hunter who wants the Children of Atom gone: a lean, weathered woman with a hunter's legs

Sandra Lee.vibe: Far Harbor islander in her going-out clothes: a fisherman's town body, full and strong

Debby.vibe: the Last Plank's waitress in a frilly maid's outfit, in a bar full of fishermen: a buxom barmaid

Miranda.vibe: Acadia synth who chose to forget what she was: a sleek, made-to-measure body that does not know it

Jule.vibe: Acadia's synth guard in a bodysuit: an athlete's body to a factory spec -- long, lean muscle

Dixie.vibe: Disciple in a raider bikini, Nisha's kind: a bladed, starved body, ribs and tendons, nothing soft

Sierra Petrovita.vibe: the Commonwealth's greatest Nuka-Cola fan, in a party dress, who has drunk the product for years: bubbly, round and soft, a soda belly

Shelbie Chase.vibe: Nuka-World trader in a Nuka-Cherry costume: a park mascot's perky, cheerful curves

Mackenzie Bridgeman.vibe: Nuka-World trader in a Red Rocket uniform: a pump-attendant's plain, practical body

Lola.vibe: brothel worker in lingerie, the house's favourite: lush and full, an hourglass made for her trade

Cherry.vibe: brothel worker in lingerie, the young one: petite and perky, small and round

Lana Lafferty.vibe: the karaoke bar's headline singer in an evening gown: a showgirl's glamour hourglass

Sonja.vibe: the karaoke "Sad Singer" in a party dress no one is celebrating in: slender, drooping, her shoulders fallen

Maisie.vibe: Interesting NPCs' Maisie in a dress: a pretty, soft, girl-next-door figure

Penelope.vibe: Interesting NPCs' Penelope in a secretary's suit: a prim pencil-skirt figure, slim and neat

Switch.vibe: raider in furs: a big, brawling body, heavy shoulders and thick limbs

Spitball.vibe: raider in a sleeveless top, a scrappy runt with a nasty nickname: skinny, wiry, small

Rabbit.vibe: a Jet-fueled bar's girl in club clothes, jittery on her own stock: bony and twitchy, jet-thin

Harley Evans.vibe: swamp settler of South of the Sea in work clothes: a strong, sun-and-mud body, broad and capable

Doctor Kane.vibe: Enclave medic: military fitness standards kept to the letter -- trim, toned, nothing out of regulation

Quartermaster Barratt.vibe: Enclave quartermaster: years of counting crates -- a stocky, thick-waisted supply sergeant

Christine Stennett.vibe: Vault 4's doctor in a dark nurse's uniform, whose vault keeps what it bred out of sight: cool and clinical, slender and long-limbed

Paula McKenzie.vibe: Vault 4 dweller in a vault suit: soft and pale from a life underground

Susan Janeway.vibe: Vault 4 dweller, a captain's name and a captain's bearing: upright, fit and square-shouldered

Kate Armstrong.vibe: Vault 4's Kate Armstrong, living up to the name: big strong arms on a sturdy frame

June Waters.vibe: Vault 4 dweller in a maid's vault suit: a plump, homely housekeeper

Nadine.vibe: Point Lookout survivor in leathers: swamp-lean and hard, a body the bayou boiled down

Marguerite.vibe: Point Lookout local in street clothes: a full, warm, generous figure

Panada.vibe: Point Lookout local in casual clothes: a short, round, sturdy body

Marcella.vibe: Point Lookout runner in sporty clothes: a long-legged athlete's body, lean and quick

Lisa.vibe: Goodneighbor clubgoer in club clothes: slim, made for the dance floor

Sasha.vibe: Goodneighbor nightlife in lingerie: a lush, soft hourglass

Nikki.vibe: Goodneighbor nightlife in an elite bikini: a fitness-model body, toned and high-set

Pest Tilly.vibe: the Lobotomite horseman Pestilence, in heavy toxic-raider gear: disease made flesh -- a bloated, swollen belly on wasted limbs

Stingbreath.vibe: raider boss in a gas mask, who breathes poison so you don't have to: a wiry, wasp-waisted stinger

White Widow.vibe: raider boss in a harness, named for the spider: a black widow's hourglass on long, thin legs

Kelly Canhead.vibe: raider boss in a jacket, called Canhead: a thick-skulled brute -- heavy, broad, beer-bellied

Confessor Campbell.vibe: the Confessor of Shady Motives in office clothes, who hears everyone's secrets: a buttoned-up, narrow, severe body that gives none away

Daisy.vibe: Goodneighbor's ghoul shopkeeper, two hundred years past the bombs, still dressed for the club: a withered, sagging old body that never stopped going out

Overseer Barstow.vibe: the Vault-Tec Workshop's ghoul Overseer in armoured vault blue, a company woman to the bone: a stocky, square-cut middle manager

Sammy.vibe: South of the Sea's ghoul in street clothes: a scrawny, rangy survivor, all knuckles and knees

Preston Garvey.vibe: earnest Minuteman: lean, a little gaunt from hard years

Paladin Danse.vibe: Brotherhood paladin: big and heavily muscled, thick neck and traps

Robert MacCready.vibe: young mercenary: skinny, narrow-shouldered, all elbows

Deacon.vibe: the spy nobody remembers: perfectly average

Arthur Maxson.vibe: the young Elder: broad, imposing, heavy-built

X6-88.vibe: Courser: athletic and lean-muscled, built to a spec

Old Longfellow.vibe: old hunter: stringy and weathered, a drinker's gut

Porter Gage.vibe: raider lieutenant: a stocky bruiser with a gut

Sturges.vibe: mechanic: solid, broad-chested, a bit of a belly

Kellogg.vibe: mercenary: compact and dense, hard muscle

Travis Miles.vibe: nervous DJ: soft, narrow-shouldered, an indoor body

Mayor McDonough.vibe: the fat cat of "Mankind for McDonough", who threw the ghouls out and smiles a mile-long smile: a heavy, soft politician (S-94, alasdairn for the owner, 2026-10-18: "more natural"; was grossly obese, a 135% stomach that ballooned his suit sideways)

Vadim Bobrov.vibe: barkeep: a big beer belly, heavy arms

Moe Cronin.vibe: Swatters' owner: a pot belly on thin legs

Father.vibe: the Institute's director, sixty and dying: thin and frail

Paladin Brandis.vibe: hermit survivor: gaunt, the muscle wasted away

John.vibe: Cathy's son at the Super Salon, "practically deaf in this ear" from ma's yelling: henpecked -- narrow shoulders, soft, a mama's boy's hips

Arturo Rodriguez.vibe: Commonwealth Weaponry, "the real secret is in the mods": an ordinary dad body with over-modded arms

Solomon.vibe: Chem-I-Care, slightly stoned: "all the chems you need to ... balance you out" -- and nothing about him is balanced: sunken chest, stick limbs, a soft little gut

Doctor Sun.vibe: the doctor who "can cure just about anything" and scorns facial surgery as not real medicine: a hollow, bony ascetic who forgets to eat

Abbot.vibe: one of the oldest citizens, keeper of the Wall ("the great, green guardian"): he has become one -- old, broad, square and barrel-bellied

Sheffield.vibe: the market's former alcoholic, "doctors said I shot my liver", begging for Nuka-Cola: stick limbs and a swollen gut

Malcolm Latimer.vibe: the rich man who "practically runs Diamond City", pays the mayor and hires others for his dirty work, confidence "Cowardly": a pampered pear that never lifted anything

Finn.vibe: Goodneighbor's "insurance" man, confidence "Foolhardy", who tells Hancock there will be a new mayor: all mouth -- a scrawny runt

Wayne Delancy.vibe: the Goodneighbor hitman who killed Miss Selmy and her child for two caps and calls drifters "meat": gaunt, sinewy and hungry

Parker Quinn.vibe: the charge-card con man of South Boston: all show, like his card -- a pumped chest and arms on chicken legs (the joke is the scam; his face is modelled on a real person, his body is not)

Winlock.vibe: the Gunner who tells MacCready "we know how to play the game", O-positive tattooed on his forehead: the big, broad boss of the pair

Barnes.vibe: Winlock's sidekick: "Winlock, tell me we don't have to listen to this shit..." -- short-armed, soft and narrow beside him

Rufus Rubins.vibe: the Hotel Rexford handyman who works for room and board and waits politely for Magnolia to finish singing: the one honest body in Goodneighbor -- wiry and work-strong

Hancock.vibe: Goodneighbor's ghoul mayor, who took a chem to become one and wears a frock coat over it: a lean, ropy, showman's body, all sinew

Jack Cabot.vibe: the Cabots' scholar, kept young for centuries on the serum, never far from a book: a soft, pale, narrow-shouldered gentleman

Lorenzo Cabot.vibe: the brother locked in Parsons asylum for decades, the Artifact's power in his blood: a wasted prisoner's frame with the ropes of something unnatural under it

Edward Deegan.vibe: the Cabots' ghoul bodyguard, two centuries in the job: a big, old, heavy guard gone thick at the middle

Ham.vibe: the Third Rail's ghoul bouncer: a wide door of a man, barrel chest and heavy arms

Kent Connolly.vibe: the ghoul who listens to the Silver Shroud all day in Memory Den's back room: a fan, not a hero -- skinny, round-shouldered, soft little belly

Marowski.vibe: Goodneighbor's chem kingpin, who never touches his own stock or his own dirty work: a soft, well-fed back-room boss

Doc Crocker.vibe: Diamond City's face surgeon with a past he cut away: a dry, narrow, tidy man, clean hands, no muscle

Bobby De Luca.vibe: Vault 81's chem addict who wants to dig his way out: twitchy and hollow, a junkie's stick body

Jacob Orden.vibe: Covenant's smiling founder, whose perfect little town hides a torture lab: a pleasant, well-kept, comfortable middle-aged body -- too comfortable

Old Man Stockton.vibe: old caravan man of Bunker Hill, a lifetime on the road: shrunken and bowed, legs still hard from walking

Henry Cooke.vibe: the Colonial Taphouse owner, a gangster in an apron: a heavy, well-fed tavern boss

Danny Sullivan.vibe: the Diamond City gate guard who opens the doors for you: a plain, regulation guardsman

Abraham Finch.vibe: the Finch farm's patriarch, a hard old farmer: big work hands, thick shoulders, a settled gut

Sinjin.vibe: the raider boss who came for Kill or Be Killed's gang war: a big, mean brawler

Bullet.vibe: raider boss who calls himself Bullet: wiry and quick, a lean fighter

Skinny Malone.vibe: the Triggermen boss of Vault 114, called Skinny: he is not -- a crime boss's gut on a soft, heavy body

Pickman.vibe: the painter who murders raiders for his art: gaunt and long-boned, a hollow, starved artist

Zeke.vibe: the Atom Cats' leader, a power-armour greaser: a mechanic's strong forearms and a cocky chest

Captain Kells.vibe: the Prydwen's Lancer-Captain, who runs the ship by the book: a fit, stiff officer's body

Proctor Teagan.vibe: the Prydwen's quartermaster, who trades but never fights: a soft supply officer's belly

Proctor Quinlan.vibe: the Prydwen's head scribe, who would rather read about the world than walk it: a thin, stooped archivist

Knight Rhys.vibe: Danse's hothead knight, who wants every mutant dead: a hard, aggressive, muscled soldier

Doctor Carrington.vibe: the Railroad's grumpy doctor, who tells you everyone else is incompetent: thin, sour, round-shouldered

Drummer Boy.vibe: the Railroad's youngest courier, eager and underfed: a skinny kid of a man

Alan Binet.vibe: head of the Institute's Robotics, bitter at being outranked: a soft, sedentary engineer

Max Loken.vibe: the Institute's ambitious young synth-retention head: groomed and fit, a climber's gym body

Clayton Holdren.vibe: the Institute's old director of Advanced Systems: a thin old academic, chest gone hollow

Newton Oberly.vibe: the Institute's gentle director of BioScience, who grows the food: well fed on it -- round and mild

Jun Long.vibe: the Concord survivor broken by his son's death, who sits and stares: a slumped, deflated body

Clint.vibe: the Gunner who led the Quincy massacre, Tessa's partner in it: a thick, brutal heavy

Allen Lee.vibe: Far Harbor's gunsmith, a grouch who hates everyone and the fog most: a squat, sour, thick-necked man

Teddy Wright.vibe: Far Harbor's fisherman: a rope-hauler's heavy shoulders and forearms over a working belly

Brooks.vibe: the harbour's gruff old islander who saved his rifle for the fog: weathered and stringy, old but tough

Mitch.vibe: Far Harbor islander: an ordinary, sturdy fisherman

Faraday.vibe: Acadia's synth scientist, polite and precise: a slight, neat, unassuming lab body

High Confessor Tektus.vibe: the Children of Atom's High Confessor, who hungers for the Glow and power: a rad-fed zealot -- an ascetic chest over a self-satisfied paunch

Mason.vibe: the Pack's alpha, who rules by strength alone: a huge, pumped, savage body

Overboss Colter.vibe: Nuka-World's Overboss, who never leaves his power armour: soft and lazy inside the steel

William Black.vibe: the Operators' second, Mags' brother: sleek and cold, a slim, tailored killer

Shank.vibe: Nuka-World's fixer, ex-Pack and ex-Disciple, now the go-between: a worn, wiry survivor

Oswald.vibe: Oswald the Outrageous, the ghoul magician of the Kiddie Kingdom: a stage magician's pot belly on spindly limbs

Harvey.vibe: trader in Nuka-World, minding his stall under the raiders' guns: a nervous, ordinary, soft trader

War.vibe: the Lobotomite horseman War: a slab of brutal muscle, bred for the fight

Fat Min.vibe: the Lobotomite horseman Famine -- "Fat Min": the one rider who never went hungry, enormous and soft

Crazy Marty.vibe: Crazy Marty of the Lobotomite pack: a jittery, scrawny wild man

Tobar.vibe: Tobar the ferryman, who rows you to Point Lookout for a price: an oarsman's broad back and arms on a lean, salt-dried body

Obadiah Blackhall.vibe: Obadiah Blackhall, the swamp's old moonshiner patriarch: a gaunt old backwoodsman with a liquor belly

Mayor Wayne Sanders.vibe: Fourville's mayor in Vault 4: a small-town politician's soft, prosperous paunch

Father of the Four.vibe: the Father of the Four, Vault 4's prophet: a gaunt, robed holy man, all bone and certainty

Hailstorm.vibe: Hailstorm, the raider boss holding the radio facility: a hulking, heavy-handed brute

Doctor Armstrong.vibe: Doctor Armstrong of the Institute: a lab man with nothing of his name -- thin arms, soft middle

Angelo.vibe: Angelo of Shady Motives, the man with a secret worth hiding: a fit, ordinary, presentable body

Doctor Cabbage.vibe: Dr. Cabbage of Shady Motives, named like a vegetable and shaped like one: short, round and leafy-soft

Knight-Captain Cade.vibe: the Prydwen's doctor in an esquire's uniform: a fit, upright middle-aged medic who keeps to regulation

Knight Gavil.vibe: a Brotherhood knight in light combat armour: a drilled, solid soldier

Initiate Clarke.vibe: a raw Brotherhood recruit in borrowed fatigues: lanky and untrained, not filled out yet

Scribe Faris.vibe: the scribe of Brandis's lost recon squad, in field armour he never grew into: a narrow, bookish body

Justin Ayo.vibe: head of Synth Retention, who hunts escaped synths in an expedition suit: a hard, trim, cold enforcer

Dean Volkert.vibe: the Institute's fussy Facilities director: a soft, pear-shaped administrator

Evan Watson.vibe: Institute Synth Retention man in casual clothes: an ordinary, average office body

Isaac Karlin.vibe: BioScience's nervous researcher: thin, round-shouldered, a little hunched over his samples

Calvin Whitaker.vibe: Vault 81 dweller in a pilot's jacket over his suit, dreaming of the sky: a slim, keen young man

Neil Freund.vibe: Vault 81 dweller in canvas vault gear: soft and pale, a life spent indoors

Holt Combes.vibe: Vault 81's security man in a plated suit, a father on guard: a square, sturdy body

Jacob Forsythe.vibe: Vault 81's scavver in patched vault gear, the one who goes outside: lean and capable

Mark Summerset.vibe: Vault 81 dweller in the general suit: a comfortable, middle-aged, middle-everything body

Yefim Bobrov.vibe: Vadim's brother at the Dugout Inn, the one who worries while Vadim drinks the profits: wiry and tense, all the belly went to his brother

Eddie Winter.vibe: the gangster who turned himself into a ghoul to wait out two hundred years in a bunker: a thick, heavy mob boss in a duster

Fred Allen.vibe: Goodneighbor's chem addict who wants you to run his errands for a fix: a hollowed-out jet-stick

Blake Abernathy.vibe: Abernathy farm's father in overalls, grieving and working: a lean, worn farmer with hard forearms

Roger Warwick.vibe: Warwick Homestead's stubborn, eccentric farmer in white overalls: a stringy, stiff, sun-dried man

Jake Finch.vibe: the Finch farm's boy who ran off to the raiders, stars and stripes on his back: young, cocky, lean muscle he is proud of

Daniel Finch.vibe: Jake's older brother who stayed on the farm: broad and steady, a worker's shoulders

Lucas Miller.vibe: caravan trader on the roads between settlements: a walker's lean legs and a sun-browned, wiry frame

Honest Dan.vibe: caravan guard for hire, hunting what killed his caravan: a seasoned, solid fighter

Captain Baker.vibe: the Gunner officer at Quincy in spec-ops kit: a hard, fit professional killer

Bluejay.vibe: the Atom Cats' hipster in raider-chic: skinny, cool, too cool to lift anything

Brother Ward.vibe: a Child of Atom in the Crater, in burrower robes: a rad-starved ascetic, ribs and faith

Brother Ogden.vibe: a Child of Atom in the Crater, in boarder robes: an ordinary convert, plain and a little thin

Brother Foster.vibe: a Child of Atom in the Crater, in rider robes: lean and hard from the glowing road

Brother Griffith.vibe: a Child of Atom in the Crater, in burgher robes: the well-fed one, soft and round under the brown cloth

Grand Zealot Richter.vibe: the Nucleus's Grand Zealot, Atom's soldier in combatant robes: a big, militant, muscled zealot

Zealot Ware.vibe: a Nucleus zealot in contender robes: a lean, fervent fighter

Brother Kane.vibe: a Child of Atom of the Nucleus in rover robes: an average, mild believer

Brother Devin.vibe: a Child of Atom of the Nucleus, a hooded ranger of the fog: wiry and quiet

Andre Michaud.vibe: Far Harbor islander in lumberjack overalls: a big, burly woodsman
